value_updates.normal_operation_role: Primary source for the ESP32-S3, INA219, downstream 3.3V sensors, I2C display, TTP223, AM312, and SK6812 Mini-E LEDs when the power board is connected

decisions.reason: The charge-status display method and dedicated charge-LED interface remain valid unchanged; their electrical supply is owned by the addressable-LED interface requirement.
The LED part voltage does not alter the defined interboard connector partition, connector types, signal pinout, or pin-order policy.
The AXP2101 remains the normal-operation source for all system loads, so its existing general load-coverage state requires no change.
The LED supply decision does not affect USB enumeration, flashing, connector sourceability, or USB data routing.
The current 5V-boost load list already excludes the LEDs, and the source does not change its converter, control, rating, or remaining sensor loads.
The addressable-LED voltage does not resolve or alter the battery connector family, part number, pin functions, or unresolved pin order.
The source identifies an LED electrical specification but does not change the power-board BOM readiness, sourcing, or charge-LED component decisions.
The LED supply voltage has no effect on the I2C pull-ups, cable-length constraint, bus speed, or series-resistor policy.
The LED supply decision does not change battery protection requirements, cutoff voltages, or DW01A protection components.
